rationale: Dialog selects and sourcePicker already exist in stable v1.82.0 (src/editors/form-kit.ts). This unifies their existing presentation with the accepted UI-029 and fixes source overflow and adaptive nested Escape, without a new stored capability or changed option set.

summary.ru: Единое оформление списков и выбора иконок в диалогах; длинные источники остаются в пределах окна.
summary.en: Consistent dialog dropdowns and icon selection, with long sources kept inside the dialog.
